_about: Profiles are groups; projects are users. A project gets capability only from the profiles attached to it in projects.json, plus every profile in 'default_profiles'. Allowed = union of those profiles' plugins and connectors. 'deny_plugins' / 'deny_connectors' always win over any grant. Connectors are denied by default: a claude.ai connector no attached profile grants is turned off (names are written without the 'claude.ai ' prefix). Keep profiles small and single-purpose so they compose.

plugin_accounts._about: Optional notes on where each plugin comes from; the page offers these ids when you add a plugin to a profile.

baseline.description: Attached to every project. No plugins, no connectors.

secure-code.description: Flags risky edits as you go. For security-sensitive code.

docs.description: Notes, writing and reference folders. Built-ins only.
